calculation.description: Rolling 60-day regression beta of each tradable asset's daily return on BTC daily return. Captures cross-asset crypto risk linkage: assets whose returns co-move with BTC (crypto-adjacent beta) tend to persist in relative performance over 10d. Positive IC in all three regimes; strongest 2025-26.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on 15-asset cross-asset universe; 629 IC dates with >=8 valid instruments. IC by regime: 2020-22 +0.0615 (ICIR 0.156), 2023-24 +0.0311 (ICIR 0.077, weaker), 2025-26 +0.1080 (ICIR 0.237, strong). Decay increases with horizon (h=20 IC 0.0845), i.e. signal is slow/persistent, not mean-reverting.

signal_artifact.description: Factor signal panel: rows = dates (YYYY-MM-DD), cols = 15 watchlist symbols. Recover with zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(data)).decode() -> pandas.read_csv(StringIO).
